entry.title: ‘Unflappable’ Norris Wins + Mercedes Are Champions! | Sao Paulo GP Review | F1 Nation Podcast

media:group.media:title: ‘Unflappable’ Norris Wins + Mercedes Are Champions! | Sao Paulo GP Review | F1 Nation Podcast
media:group.media:description:
F1 Nation is brought to you by AWS - Global AI Partner of Formula 1.
Tom Clarkson and James Hinchcliffe are in the Interlagos paddock to dissect the Sao Paulo Grand Prix, as Lando Norris took his third race win of the season and Mercedes became Constructors’ World Champions for the ninth time in their history.
How did Lando make the difference in the wet and dry conditions this weekend? And how big a step forward is this result for McLaren?
Max Verstappen delivered another sensational drive through the field in Brazil to climb 19 places from P21 to P2, with Isack Hadjar coming home in third to secure a double podium for Red Bull. How did Max complete another magical comeback? And what have we learned about Isack this weekend?
Both Kimi Antonelli and George Russell had eventful races, but still scored the points needed to ensure Mercedes claimed their first title since 2021. Tom and Hinch discuss how Merc have returned to the top and reflect on a chaotic weekend for their drivers.
Also on the agenda: a frustrating end to a challenging week for Ferrari, another stellar performance from Liam Lawson, and Rafa Camara’s F1 debut.
